$comment: Its presence means onboarding has run; absence means onboard.
Committable: it holds no credentials. Those live in .openfable/.env.
Written by onboarding, editable by hand, regenerated by `setup`.
$skill_version: Version of the skill that generated docker-compose.yml. Compared on load; a mismatch means the template has moved on and the stack should be regenerated.
$onboarded: When onboarding completed. Null if the user skipped and took defaults — still counts as onboarded, so they are not asked again.
$skipped: True if the user declined the interview. Defaults were used; `setup` re-runs it properly.
$compose_template: Which compose template was generated: all-local | external-db | external-embeddings | external-both.
$database: container | external. External means OPENFABLE_DATABASE_URL is set in .env and migrations run against a database the user owns.
$embeddings: source is container | external. model and dimensions are recorded so a later change can be detected: switching model against an existing corpus silently degrades retrieval, because stored vectors are from the old model and nothing errors.
$defaults: Behavioural preferences, not deployment config. NOT collected during onboarding — a user cannot sensibly choose a token budget before running a query. These accumulate from use, and the values here are the starting points.
